title: Economics v3.0: Rebalance minting to match network spending
summary: Reduce mint_quantity from 125,000 to 5,800 MIRAGE per interval (~21x reduction), increase mint_dynamic_split from 0.50 to 0.75, and raise mint_dynamic_credit_cap from 25 to 100. Current minting is 18M MIRAGE/day but network spending is only ~336K/day (54x overshoot). New minting targets ~840K/day (~2.5x spending) which keeps active nodes profitable (PROD earns ~317K vs ~280K spend = 13% margin) while dramatically reducing inflation. The higher dynamic split (75% activity-weighted, 25% baseline) and increased credit cap (100 vs 25) reward validators that relay more transactions, allowing greater differentiation between high and low activity nodes.
